S6:2.text: And Abram ſaid: Lord God, what wilt thou giue me? I thal goe without children:and the ſonne of the ſteward of my houſe is this Damaſcus Eliezer.

S6:3.text: .And Abram added: But to me thou haſt not giuen ſeed and loe my ſcruant borne in my houſe ſhal be mine heire.

S6:4.text: And immediately the word of our Lord came to him ſaying: He ſhal not be thine heire: but he that that come out of thy womb him ſhalt thou haue thine heire.
